front_negative: Melted or fused metal, tangled ornamentation, distorted chain links, disconnected fragments, chaotic protrusions, intersecting metal surfaces, collapsed star geometry, incomplete or obscured hexagram, asymmetry, irregular thickness, paper-thin metal, excessive tiny surface noise, clay or wax appearance, low visibility, clipped chain, dramatic shadows, tilted camera, perspective distortion, extra props, text, watermark.
sheet_negative: Different medallion design in each panel, changed center symbol, missing spikes or skulls, inconsistent chain link counts, duplicate or fused links, asymmetric rotations, mismatched object scale, camera tilt, perspective distortion, mirrored or identical front and back details where unrealistic, front-facing side views, inconsistent metals, altered silhouette, cropped panels, split or merged panels, text, labels, watermark.
sheet_consistency: The supplied front reference is the absolute geometric and material identity of the pendant. Produce four true orthographic views of one unchanged 3D medallion, front at 0 degrees, left at 90 degrees, back at 180 degrees, right at 270 degrees. Keep the central raised six-pointed star, skull placements, spike silhouette, chain attachment and individually linked chain physically consistent. Side views must show genuine material thickness and relief depth; they must not flatten into a repeated front. Back view must have the same external contour and plausible solid metal backing, not an unrelated design. Exactly four equal-width panels in a single horizontal strip, same object size and vertical registration, neutral lighting. Do not invent new ornaments or reassemble the chain.
